Rebased onto master `ad858a28b` at `8061d2dcb`, including the C++20 utility migration and parallel CI layout. Workflow conflicts retain the scoped-gradient harness and current shared-runtime test names. Writer/replay 123, network 46, save floor 58; historical loader gates remain unchanged. Fresh local and cross-platform validation is running. Earlier integrated validation passed, but is not a substitute for checks on this revision. Historical performance figures below do not establish gains for this combined revision.

Forbidden-zone brushes currently discard unrelated walking fields, including fields whose edited tiles already contain blocking resources and fields belonging to other teams. Scope those invalidations to affected walking and clearing inputs while still clearing own-team harvest round trips. Preserve existing staleness and unfinished lazy searches.

Escape fields now receive an independent bounded refresh slot every eight ticks. Uniform-cost classes first check their input markers, avoiding propagation when unchanged. This prevents the reduced incidental refreshes from leaving depleted escape exits stale indefinitely.

This intentionally changes simulation decisions. Replay floor/save writer are 123 and network protocol is 46. Save floor remains 58, including support for version-120 pending gradient fields and version-121 AI random streams and version-122 private runtime caches. The user explicitly approved this behavior change; merge awaits successful technical checks.

## Completed validation

Frozen baseline `37ffbcb05` versus candidate `9e62e9c75`: 512 eight-player games, 16 map families × 8 new seeds × Maxima/Nicowar × baseline/candidate. 510 games completed; one Nicowar pair failed in both versions due to runaway dig-out order allocation. Failures are preserved, not replaced by fixed runs.

All-player, matched-window results with map-family/seed hierarchical 95% intervals:

| AI | Wheat | Meals |
|---|---:|---:|
| Maxima, 128 completed pairs | +1.94% [−1.14%, +4.92%] | +2.11% [−1.18%, +5.17%] |
| Nicowar, 127 completed pairs | +0.22% [−3.10%, +3.78%] | +0.02% [−3.71%, +3.85%] |

Both clear the prospective −5% wheat/meal lower-bound guardrail among completed games. Hunger/starvation intervals include zero; this is not proof of equivalence. Canals/Plantations aggregate concerns from earlier two-player tests do not repeat directionally across these eight new seeds. Subgroup results are exploratory, not a claim that every map improves.

1,024 quiet timed runs: identical 64 developed states on each host, both source origins, four randomized paired repetitions, equal endpoints, independent physical cores; profiles separate from timings. Input hashes and endpoints match across hosts.

| Host | Overall CPU change (95% interval) | Maxima | Nicowar |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| therig | −6.93% [−8.52%, −5.41%] | −2.10% | −11.53% |
| devlaptop | −7.53% [−9.21%, −5.86%] | −3.09% | −11.76% |

CPU inference is clustered by map family; repeated runs are not independent games. CPU states use one seed per family. Identical starting states may diverge afterward, so these are whole-simulation CPU changes, not pure kernel gains. Separate Canals/Plantations profiles show 13–31% fewer building-field rebuilds with population-time changes of roughly −2% to +1%, supporting a direct reduction in work.

## Earlier evidence and remaining limits

The earlier 320-game cohort and 40 isolation games are retained separately, not pooled. The apparent 25% Nicowar meal loss was a team-0-only mirror artifact; the corrected two-team estimate was −2.7% with wide uncertainty. The behavior-preserving exact-escape prototype saved only 0.25% CPU, interval [−0.67%, +0.10%]; no reliable gain was established.

Initial candidate macOS/Linux eight-player checks matched 24,576 full/resumed records and save/resume checks matched 8,192 ticks per platform. The historical v115 fixture mismatch occurred before reload; separate candidate save/resume passed. Replay fixtures and version assertions have been updated for the integrated policy. The user approved merging; remaining CI, including browser/native equivalence, must pass first.

The separate Nicowar fix is excluded from these experiments. Its diagnostic game completed at about 272 MiB peak RSS versus the original ~100 GiB OOM; 65,536 full ticks match across macOS/Linux and 32,768 resumed ticks match on each. Its standalone branch validation is still separate work.

Reviewable [report](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/188c990b86796e9b69c23a1f65e0157286573f65/artifacts/gradient-eight-player/REPORT.md), [protocol](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/188c990b86796e9b69c23a1f65e0157286573f65/artifacts/gradient-eight-player/PROTOCOL.md), [CPU data](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/188c990b86796e9b69c23a1f65e0157286573f65/artifacts/gradient-eight-player/cpu-summary.json), [gameplay data](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/188c990b86796e9b69c23a1f65e0157286573f65/artifacts/gradient-eight-player/gameplay-summary.json), scripts, paired timing rows, source hashes and extracted counters are preserved on the dedicated evidence branch. Large original saves/logs remain retained on the validation hosts. No app replacement or merge was performed.
title: Scope forbidden-zone gradient invalidation and refresh stale escape fields
